sanskrit: kālāgni rudraparyantaṃ yāvadbrahmāṇḍagocaramvāṅmayaṃ sakalaṃ yaśca trailokyaṃ sa carācaramtasmin neva layaṃ kuryāt te caiva brahmavādinaḥtryakṣaraṃ ca tridhā bhinnaṃ tristhānaṃ triguṇātmakampañcamūrti dharaṃ devaṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇamdevadānava * ? ddhānāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasāmp. 4a) brahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraḥ śiva eva caakṣaraṃ cakṣaraṃ caiva sa nāmaṃ nāmavarjitamuccāryaṃ tu hyanuccāryaṃ svaramasvarameva casa mantraṃ ca hyamantraṃ ca grāhyamagrāhyameva capraṇavaṃ yo na jānāti viśvasyā yatanaṃ paramviśeṣataḥ punarvatsa triṣu sthāneṣu saṃsthitaḥsa pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate vai vikārāvasthitaḥ prabhuḥbhuñjate jighrate caiva śṛṇu vakṣyāmi hetutaḥsukhaduḥkhānyasau vetti śītoṣṇasparśanāni caete pratyakṣato yasya dṛśyante vai ṣaḍānananānyadīpaṃ svarūpeṇa paramātmā ca labhyatetristhānāvasthitaṃ devaṃ śrotumicchāmi vai prabhotristhānāvasthitaṃ brahma tacchṛṇuṣva yathākramammukhapadme nābhipadme gatāgatiṃ karoti saḥpraṇādyā vāyavaḥ sarve vahante teṣu nāḍiṣupradhānā piṅgalā śūnya sṛjate pahare tu saḥp. 5b) nāḍi cakrasya vai tad vat piṅgalā madhyatodbhavāekakāyaṃ ca sarvāsāṃ yukti bhede pṛthak pṛthaksuṣupiṅgalā dakṣiṇaputra tratra sūryo vyavasthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00262 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iḍāmadhye sthitaṃ deva pitṛyāneti kathyatesuṣumṇā madhyamānāḍī tatrasthaṃ mokṣamārgadaśakarṇikānta sthitaṃ devamavyaktaṃ rūpavarjitamp. 6a) tāsāṃ madhye tu vai hyekā suṣumṇā nāma śrūyatetasyābhyantarasaṃlīnau prāṇāpānau vyavasthitausṛṣṭipralayarūpeṇa sthitā vetau kumārakaādhārādheya bhāvena parāpara vibhāgaśaḥtayormadhye sthitaṃ brahma anyaktaṃ rūpavarjitamnābhipadmasya vai pṛṣṭe hṛtpadmaṃ tu adho mukhamubhābhyāṃ karṇikā madhye paraṃ tadvīkṣya putrakayaṃ dṛṣṭvāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi ajanma padamavyayamyat tvayā coditaṃ praśnaṃ durvijñeyaṃ surorapina tu devyā tvayā caiva yadabhya paripṛcchitamvikṣepa vacanaṃ rakṣeccharaṇāgatavatsvataadīkṣitena dātavyamaśraddheyamanārjavodātavyaṃ dīkṣate putra gurudevāgnipūjakeparīkṣyate guruḥ śiṣyamabdāni dvādaśāni vaianena bhāvitaṃ viśvaṃ sarvameva carācaramadyame saphalā buddhiradyame saphalaṃ tapaḥmuktosmi cā?dya vai tāta bhavasaṃsārabandhanāttat tohaṃ kathayiṣyāmi prāṇāpānau yathā sthitauteṣāṃ madhye pradhānau dvau prāṇāpānau prakīrtitauyogamārgeṣu sarveṣu gatireṣā pravartatehṛtpadme nābhipadme tu dvādaśānte tathaiva caapānaḥ saṃharet prāṇaṃ prāṇopānasya vai tathā

sanskrit: udayāsta manaṃ hyetan nānyaṃ manye śikhidhvajatapate satataṃ vatsa viśvaṃ diṅmārgavīkṣaṇeyaṃ jñātvā prāpyate mokṣo yena bhūyo na jāyateahorātraṃ kṛtaṃ caiva saṅkrānti viṣvavad dvayamyat tvayā coditaṃ praśnamanākhyaṃ kathayāmitetasya śaktirbhavedeṣā udayāsta manaṃ pratip. 8b) aliṅgaṃ liṅgarūpeṇa avyaktaṃ vyaktagocarampṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśa eva caākāśaṃ grasate śaktiryathāgrastākhilaṃ jagatpralayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ mayā te kathitaṃ sutap. 20a) * * * * * * * * ākāraṃ brahmasaṃsthitamtat sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvā vahitaṃ tathāśūnyācchūnyataraṃ śūnyaṃ tacchūnyaṃ śūnyameva caśūnyasyā śūnyatāṃ brūhi yadi tuṣṭosi me prabhoaśūnyaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt sarvaśūnyā layaṃ hitamna tu jānanti taṃ śūnyamaśūnyā yena te kṛtāḥp. 20b) aśūnyaṃ teṣvamīrūpaṃ sarvagaṃ cetanātmakamvijñānaṃ jñāpakaṃ śūnyaṃ nirālambābalambhitamtaṃ śūnyaṃ śūnyamityāhurvadanti jñānabuddhayaḥsṛṣṭipralaya rohitvā cchūnyasyāśūnyatāṃ viduḥtasmādaśūnyatā śūnye nirālambhāvalambhinamvijñānajñānayogena śūnyaṃ jñeyaṃ labheṣyasip. 21a) teṣāṃ śūnyamidaṃ śūnyamajñānā yeṣu bhāvanābrahmādi stambhaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ śūnyena pūritamyathā caitanya bhāvena bodhitaṃ bhuvana trayam

sanskrit: taṃ śūnyaṃ jñāna rūpeṇa jñeyaṃ śūnyaṃ na tadguhana punaḥ śūnya bhāvastu śūnyesmiṃstattvataḥ sutanaṣṭa sūryendu vātaughairgrahanakṣatra tārakaiḥna cordhvaṃ naiva pātālaṃ mahābhūtaistu varjitamtasmin kāle tayā śaktyā cidrūpāyā śivotthitābhūtasṛṣṭi hitārthāya plāvitaṃ cākhilaṃ jagatkalpāntaṃ yāvadaṇḍaṃ tadaṇu rūpeṇasaṃsthitamaṣṭā śā vidiśaścāṣṭau madhye bījāṅkuraṃ padamtasyāṅkurasya pṛṣṭhe tu mahāpadmaṃ sitaṃ śubhampraṇavaṃ taṃ ca vijñeyaṃ padmaṃ padmadale kṣaṇamkarṇikānte sthitaṃ vatsa sarvalokapitāmahamtadā prajāpatirvatsa viśvakartā maheśvaraḥsūryakoṭi pratīkāśaṃ kalpāntāgni samaprabhamvyaktībhūtaṃ tadāvatsa diśoṣṭau gaganaṃ kṣitiḥdalāṣṭakaṃ diśaścāṣṭau brahmapadmasya ṣaṇmukhasarvaṃ praṇavasaṃbhūtaṃ cicchaktyā cetanodbhavamtacca padmasthitaṃ vatsa amṛtodadhimadhyagamtadā tasyoditā buddhiryogamabhyamanaṃ pratitasya yoga phalāvāptiścicchaktyā praṇave hṛtambrahmādi stambha paryantaṃ yāvat kālādi gocaramsarvaṃ ca khalvidaṃ brahmasvatorthaṃ brahma vādinamsarveṣāṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ praṇavaṃ yoniśakti dhṛtp. 23a) praṇavena bhavet padmaṃ cicchaktyaṅkurasannibhampraṇavaṃ yona jānāti bindunādendu bhūṣitamarddhamātrāsamudbhutaṃ praṇavaṃ sarvadā guha

sanskrit: tasminneva layaṃ kuryāt tenaivaṃ brahmavādinaḥtairjñātamamṛtaṃ teṣāmajñānaṃ ca viṣaṃ bhavettasyāpi lakṣaso hyaṃśo yojānāti sa brahmavitadhunā śrotumicchāmi strīpuṃsoścaiva sambhavamtattehaṃ kathaṃyiṣyāmi rahasyaṃ praśnapūrvakamtapaśca sumahattīrṇāṃ duṣkaraṃ cādbhutopamamparaṃ brahmaśivaṃ jñeyaṃ paraṃ sthānamanāmayamtena tuṣṭena devena cicchaktyā cetanā guhap. 24a) ārādhito hyahaṃ tena bhaktyāparamayāyadātadādi dṛṣṭa pūrvoyamevaṃ padma tanurbhavetsa tu viṣṇurvijānīyā cchaktirūpeṇa śakti dhṛtubhābhyāṃ bījarūpeṇa padmayonistṛtīyakaḥpraṇavaṃ tu bhavedeṣa a u-makṣarayojitamcaturviṃśati tatvāni puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakamanye ye kecicchārīrā vyaktā-avyakta vāyavaḥtaṃ rasaṃ brahmamityāhurānandakaraṇaṃ paramsṛṣṭirūpeṇamartyānāmamaratve vyavasthitaḥcaturdaśavidhivatsa bhūtasargaṃ carācarambrahmatejassamutpannāvagnīṣomau śikhidhvajaevaṃ sarve samārambhāḥ sarvabījeṣu saṃsthitāḥyathānyagrodha bījānāṃ nyagrodhābhyantare sthitaḥyat tvayā coditaṃ praśnaṃ tat sarvaṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukhasamutpadyanti saṃsāre yoni lakṣvāntareṣu caevaṃ kartā ca karmabhyo bhuñjate vai śubhā śubhamp. 26b) ubhābhyāṃ tatra saṃyogādbhagaliṅgasamāgame

sanskrit: yonidvārasya vai pṛṣṭhe nābhipadmaṃ sthitaṃ guharajaḥ pravartate hyasyāṃ divasāni tu ṣoḍaśatasmin bījaṃ yadā kṣiptamṛtukāle śikhidhvajapuṃset karṣa bhavet puṃsaḥ striyotkarṣe bhavet striyaḥyugme yugānu yugme strī antakālena puṃsakamp. 26a) tasya madhye sthitā vatsa piṅgalādaspṛtodbhavājāyate puruṣaścaivamānandayati sarvadāpurapraveśametaddhi amaratvaṃ ca vai bhavetjantavo gotra santānā amaratvaṃ tadā bhavetvasate satataṃ vatsa divasāni tu ṣoḍaśaḥtasya padmasya garbhoyaṃ garbhaśayyā śikhidhvajatasya madhye yadā kṣiptaṃ kṣiptaṃ bījevakalpayetduṣkṛtīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ garbhavāsaḥ prakīrtitaḥsarvaṃ cicchaktinā vyāptaṃ śivājñā coditaṃ guhaprarohaṃ kuru vṛddhiṃ ca anyathā tasya codanamtasya bījaṃ kurutyantā tayā sṛṣṭaṃ carācaramyosau yoniḥ sanidhanaṃ paramārthaṃ tu taṃ viduḥśaktirna lupyate cāsya śivayogā śikhidhvajaagnīṣomānilayutaṃ viśate parameśvaraḥastaṅgataistairnidhanaṃ dehe deheśvaro guhatatoṅkuraṃ ca padmaṃ ca tatva brahmādanantaramgāyatrī tu bhavet taistu mahādevāti nissṛtamcicchakti saṃbhavaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍa kuharodarammayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagatsarvaṃ bhūtasargaṃ carācaramcicchaktyā cetanodbhūtaṃ dvitīye māsi budbudam

sanskrit: cicchakti sambhavā hyata sarveṣāmantare sthitāḥvyaktirna dṛśyate tasya avyakta tvāt sṛjatyasaucarāṇā?macarāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ śikhivāhanataṃ nālaṃ padmagarbhasya nābhinālaṃ prakīrtitamyathā bījāṅkuraṃ vatsa avyaktaṃ naiva dṛśyatetadā vyaktaṃ bhavet kāyaṃ puruṣā kṛti saṃjñakammajjāsthi snāyumedhaṃ ca māṃsaṃ rudirameva casirānāḍī granthayaśca dvārāḥ kūrmāśca jālakāḥete cānyepi ye keciccharīrotpatti kāraṇampañcame māsi samaye na khalomāni spandanamvyaktatvaṃ sarvamaṅgānāṃ yathā yasya tu kalpitamṣaṣṭhe māsi rasān sarvān yadā te mātṛ bhojanātcicchakti cetanorthe na cetanāṃ cetate tu yaḥyadā prabudhyate cāgnirhyadisthaṃ tacca vai guhapadmatrayaṃ prabuddhyeta hyannābhi mukhasaṃsthitamliṅgadyānāḍayaḥ sarvā hṛtpadmadalasambhavāḥtairvyāptamakhilaṃ piṇḍaṃ lomāntaṃ yāvat ṣaṇmukhayathā sūryodaye sarvaṃ rasmibhirvyāpitaṃ jagatcicchakti cetanorthāṃya bahiḥ sūryaṃ śikhidhvajaaṣṭamena tu māsena buddhirgarbhasya saṃbhavettamondhakāragahane sarvaduḥkhasamākulekaliśseṣmasaṅkīrṇe māṃsāsthisnāyu saṅkaṭeteṣāṃ madhyānmahāghoraṃ narakaṃ kukṣi sambhavamnarakārṇavasaṃprakhyaṃ duḥkhakalloladussahamevaṃ sañcintyamānasya cicchaktyā coditasya ca

sanskrit: ata ūrddhvaṃ tu ye kecit garbhavāse vasanti cadarśanaṃ daśame māsi sukṛtāni tu cintayettadahaṃ tat kariṣyāmi yena bhuyo na jāyatevedeṣu sarvaśāstreṣu purāṇeṣu smṛtīṣu caevaṃ sañcintya mānasya cicchaktyā prasavaṃ kṛtamatyanta bhayabhītā tu maṇḍa udbijitā guhavidārya padmaṃ garbhasya yonidvāra mukhe gatamp. 30b) vidārya sṛṣṭiṃ dvāreṇa mātuḥ sandeha kārakamna tasya sukṛte buddhirna ca duṣkṛta karmaṇiutpattireṣābhūtānāṃ yonijānāṃ śikhidhvajatatrāpi saṃśayaṃ deva vartate dhātu saṅkṣayātp. 31a) yat tvayā coditaṃ praśnaṃ putrasnehādvadāmiteyathā vai dhātu saṃkhyānamaṅgānāṃ ca śṛṇuṣvamerasaṃ sambhavate vatsa māsamekaṃ tu niṣphalāparāgni saṃbhavaṃ taṃ vai na sa śukro bhavatyasaurasādraktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsānmedotha jāyateśukrāddhātūni sarvāṇi dhātubhyāṃ dehamānuṣamevaṃ hi prathamaṃ tāvaccharīrotpatti kāraṇamvātaṃ pittaṃ tathā śleṣmaṃ dhātavaḥ parikīrtitāḥśarīradhāraṇā hyete saṅkhyāsaṅkhyā kṛtāṃ guṇāḥtāsāṃ saṅkhyā bhavedeṣā kalpanā śikhivāhanavāyu bhāve guṇā ye ca ye vāne yau dhvane tathāatorthā dhātu pūrvāye asaṅkhyeyāvilāguhatena santarpite naiva dhātavastarpitā guhap. 32a) sa tu gandha guṇasparśaṃ bhuñjate dehasaṃsthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00262 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmād vai sarvadā vatsa sa kartāsevakāraṇamtathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni te jāyattāni sarvaśaḥsa tu māṃsaṃ samāśritya saṃsthitaṃ sarvadehināmp. 32b) māṃsaṃ peśīśatānyaṣṭau śataiketaiva cādhikaḥpittasya tu palānyaṣṭau śleṣmarakta samāśritamvasāmedaḥ pṛthaktvena ubhau viṃśatpalīnakauvasādāhārapānāṃbhyāṃ viṇmūtraṃ jāyate punaḥraktaṃ pittaṃ tathā śleṣmaṃ śukraṃ majjā tu ṣaṇmukhasarveṣāmeva dhātūnāṃ pittaṃ vai śleṣma bandhanamyasmādrasodbhavāḥ sarve tadā teṣāṃ nibandhanamasthīnāṃ tu śatāṃ trīṇi ṣaṣṭhya sthiradhikāni caaṣṭottaraṃ carmaśataṃ sirāṇāṃ sapta vai śatamgranthīnāṃ tu śataṃ vatsa aṣṭātriṃśottaraṃ tathāsnāyu jālamasaṃkhyeyaṃ yairbaddhaṃ kāyapañjaramcatuṣṣaṣṭirbhavet kūrcaṃ tayoḥ snāyūṃśca sambhavettadā yantra mayaṃ sarvaṃ śarīraṃ mānuṣātmakamtāstu vāyu vahāḥ sarvāssarvāstā mokṣadāḥ śubhāḥtadudbhavāṇi sarvāṇi yathā prāṇodbhavānilāḥtisraḥ koṭyo va koṭistu romasaṅkhyaḥ prakīrtitāḥte saṅkhye yā asaṅkhye yā ye tu dehāntare sthitālomakrāmāni sarvāṇi dvārāṇi śikhivāhanap. 34a) nakhānāṃ viṃśatiḥ proktā navadvārāṇi ṣaṇmukhaevaṃ saṅkhyā samudbhūtā śarīreṣu śarīriṇāmbhūyo vijñātu micchāmi brahmaveśma śarīrajāmyasmādbrahma mayaṃ dehamatrabrahma tu labhyate

sanskrit: yadyekona bhavet teṣāṃ tadā sarve hyapārthakāḥp. 34b) ekaikaṃ ca tathā bhūtamutpannaṃ śakti coditamtasmād yantra mayaṃ sarvaṃ śarīraṃ mānuṣātmakammāṃsarakta mṛdādigdhaṃ snāyu kīlaka kīlitamekona dhāryate stambhaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ yena dhāryatebrahmaṇo veśmano madhye vedamagni trayasya caājyendha na tilairdarbhairdhūmairgandhaiḥ srajaiḥ śubhaiḥtuṣyante tarpitāvatsa prāṇāpānāhutīṣu cajuhuyāt satataṃ vatsa prāṇāpānāvamṛtodbhavausravate satataṃ vatsa prāṇāgnau tarpaṇaṃ pratibāhyāgnītamupāsīta vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇābrahmavedirbhavedeṣā brahmaveśmasya madhyataḥsiddhānte kula siddhānte avācyaṃ yat kathaṃ ca tep. 36a) yat tvayā coditaṃ vatsa ati snehādbadāmitetasya madhye paraṃ tejo yaḥ paśyati sa paśyatiasaṅkhyā bhāsurābhāsaṃ brahmaveśmasya dīpanamnadate satataṃ yasmāt tasmān nādamihocyateabyucchinnaṃ ca taṃ nādaṃ nadate sarva dehināmanacchaṃ kecidicchanti śūnyaṃ kecitva danti cap. 36b) taṃ nādaṃ prakaṭaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ mokṣo dhruvaṃ guhatvāṃ viditvā mahāsenaṃ taṃ mokṣaṃ prāpsyase dhurvamparamāgni samudbhūtaṃ taṃ nādaṃ nadate guhadaiśikastu sa vijñeyo mokṣo vai mokṣikastu saḥyena vijñāta mātreṇa bhrānti jñānaṃ nivartateyathā vātāhate vṛkṣe śabdoyaṃ śrūyate guha

sanskrit: śṛṅgadhvani ninādena nadantaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti vaina kiñcidapi taṃ vatsa yasya taṃ na hyadi sthitamprakaṭaṃ jñāna cakṣurbhyāṃ paśyate śṛṇute tu saḥetena śrūyate nādaṃ na dantaṃ brahmasaṃbhavambrahmādi stambha paryantamākārā ye bhavanti vaigurūpadeśagamyoyaṃ yadi tuṣṭo vadatyasausa tṛptaḥ sa ca vai muktaḥ somṛtaṃ cāśnute dhruvamparaṃparagataṃ vatsa parātparataraṃ hitambrahmādi sarva bhūteṣu careṣu hyacareṣu cavyāpāreṣu sa vai kartā samastavyastakeṣu casarve ye kecid vyāpārāḥ sṛṣṭirādyāḥ kṣayāntikāḥcaturviṃśati tattvāni puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥna punastāta kauleyaṃ khecarīṇāṃ mukhesthitamyat tvayā coditaṃ praśnaṃ kaulaṃ khecari gocaramtaṃ hi siddhyanti tāsāṃ vai tāstasmiṃstejasā guhakuvikalpagatānāṃ vai satyaṃ vatsa na siddhyatipibanti rūpikāstaṃ tu nāḍimāśritya madhyamāmdevān pitṛstarpayanti kulanāḍyāṃsta saṃsthitāḥna punarhomahavanairyajñaiśca bahudakṣiṇaiḥvivarte hyamṛtaṃ vatsa hṛdisthaṃ yatparaṃ padambhairavastarpitaṃ tāsāṃ dharme ca paśuṃ prokṣaṇemokṣaśca nihitaṃ yajñe bhairavokteṣu sarvadāanena vidhinā vatsa hiṃsanti paśavo yadip. 39a) siddhyate mahatāṃ siddhiraṣṭasiddhisamanvitākasyedaṃ viditaṃ jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ vijñāna sammitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00262 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paśūnāṃ caiva sarveṣāmādikartā prajāpatiḥvedayajñeṣu paśavo hiṃsanti brāhmaṇottamāḥsūkṣmapuryaṣṭakaṃ yacca bhūtānāṃ hṛdi saṃsthitamprāṇāpānodaye tasmin bindunāda layaṃ gatāḥgatireṣā hi caiteṣāṃ tadātmetaṃ labhanti hiprāṇāpānapravāhena na viditvā pibanti hi* * * * * * * * * * bhakṣyāni kāni tubhairavoktena vidhinā samyag yoga balena tusa siddhaḥ sādhakaḥ sohi śeṣā vai madhyamāḥ smṛtāḥkṣīraṃ tu kurute madhyaṃ saṃśaye samupasthiteprāṇāpānāntara caronāḍi tritaya yāyinaḥp. 40a) sauraṃmārgaṃ parityajya cāndraṃ mārgaṃ tathaiva cayena vijñāta mātreṇa bhrānti jñānaṃ nivartateyat tvayā coditaṃ praśnaṃ nissandigdhaṃ vadāmyahamsaṃsthitā sarvabhūteṣu jagadurddhraṃ? yayākhilamgrasate sṛjate śaktiśśivājñā jñāpitā guhavayaṃ pitāmahaṃ viṣṇuṃ na bīndvanalameva cabhūyo bhūyo hi jāyante bhūyo bhūyo mriyanti caśaktirna lupyate sā vai paramādvaita vartinīyayāvyāptamidaṃ viśvaṃ bhūtasargaṃ carācaramekaikaṃ maṇimāśritya yathāviddhyanti vedhakāḥsūtraṃ tāsāṃ śivaṃ sākṣāt tena te grathitā guhamahābhūtāni sarvāṇi sarve cicchakti sambhavāḥna hi jānanti tāṃ mūḍhā mahāmāyā vimohitāḥsthitā sā agni rūpeṇa sarvatra vāyunāśritā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00262 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmaveśma bhaved dehaṃ jñānaṃ tatraiva dīpakamtaṃ dṛṣṭyā te gamiṣyanti ajanma padamavyayamsaṃsthitā sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ śikhidhvajavayaṃ brahmādibhissārdhaṃ naiva muktāḥ śikhidhvajaanyepi yoginaḥ sarve makṣamārgānu kāṅkṣiṇaḥkāraṇaṃ tatra vai hyekaṃ yukti bhedaḥ pṛthak pṛthakrājasaṃ svargakāmānāṃ nārakaṃ tamasā vṛtamrājasaṃ mānuṣairvatsa svargā vāpti phalapradamtasmāt sarvaprayatnena sātvikaṃ yāgamārabhetp. 42a) sātvikaṃ mānasaṃ yāgaṃ tatra hiṃsā na vidyatemānase naiva yāgena ye yajanti sadāśivamdravyaśuddhistu paramaṃ sambhāraṃ yeṣu krīyatetadā taṃ dravya sambhāraṃ śuddho bhavati ṣaṇmukhayaṣṭaṃ hi nirmalaṃ tena pratyutatṛṇavadbhavettadarthaṃ na vimuktāste ye yajanti sadā dhanaiḥp. 42b) tad deyaṃ devagurave vipre vā brahmavādineakṣayyaṃ bhavate vatsa kalpakoṭi śatairapisaṃbhārā ye bahirkecit sarve cicchakti sambhavāḥsa jīvāni tu te sarve śivaṃ teṣāṃ hṛdi sthitamsa jīvāḥ paśavo jñeyāstarujātīnisarvaśaḥye sthitāḥ phalasandho *? vaśyākarṣaṇamāraṇaiḥp. 43a) caturdaśavidhaṃ vatsa bhūtasargaṃ carācaramadhunā śrotumicchāmi iṣṭamiṣṭoturottaramtadā sa tuṣṭo bhagavāñśivopyaśivahāparaḥahiṃsā sarvabhūteṣu careṣu hyacareṣu ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00262 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hiṃsākṣaraṃ vijānīyāt tasmāt taṃ parivarjayetye yajanti hitaṃ vatsa te muktā bhavabandhanātajñānādupadeśasya śivajñāna bahiṣkṛtaḥniṣprapañcaṃ paraṃ tatvamaparaṃ tu parāparamtasya yāgaṃ ca kurvīta niṣprapañcaṃ hi mānusammanasai tāni kartavyaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇātadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi yathārthaṃ tadbravīhi mesarve tiṣṭhanti tatraiva mānase tvakhilā guhatatrasthaṃ saṅgamaṃ vatsa śivaṃ nādātmakaṃ śubhampravāhaṃ tasya tīrthasya suṣumṇāḍyāntare sthitamna cātra vighnā hiṃsanti duṣṭā ye vai carācarenā cātra hiṃsā dṛśyeta na tu pītvā karaṃ tathātepi tiṣṭanti cāteva ātmaśuddhyartha kāraṇamśivatīrthena tiṣṭhanti mānase aśivāpaheuttaptāste sadā vighnairdivyabhaumāntarikṣagaiḥanorthādbāhyatīrthāni varjitāni sadā guhayasmād bādhā bhavet teṣāṃ tasmāt tāstu vivarjayetamṛtaṃ sravate nityaṃ piṅgalābhyantare sthitamsvarṇopalabdhi vimalaṃ sā nandaṃ nandaśītalamtasmin snānaṃ sadā kuryād vidhi dṛṣṭena karmaṇāyat kiñciditi kartavyaṃ tat sarvaṃ mānasaṃ kurusarve tiṣṭhanti cātraiva ahiṃsā tu samarpitāḥetaddhi paramaṃ tīrthamayaṃ hi paramo japaḥbāhyatīrthāni tuṣṭāni mantrān bāhyāṃstu sarvaśaḥtīrtheṣu ye sthitāḥ keciddīnādyāḥ prāṇino guha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00262 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivatīrthaparijñānātsamyagyoga balena tuna cātra hiṃsate kaścin na tilāndarbha eva casmaraṇā cchivatīrthasya na kiñcidapi lupyatebhūyo vijñātumicchāmi dhyānaṃ deheśvarātmakampratyakṣaṃ ca parokṣaṃ ca adhunā darśayāmitetaiḥ prāpyamakhilaṃ vatsa mokṣamārgaṃ na saṃśayaḥtaiḥ śuddhāḥ sarvadā vatsa yatra yatrāśrame sthitāḥp. 46b) sa tu mantraṃ śivaṃ śāstraṃ kṣetraṃ hi paramaṃ tu saḥdarśanādeva vai tasya naśyante ca diśo daśakaraṇena tu saṃpaśyet samyag yoga balena tuetad yathārthaṃ yuñjīta tato dhyānaṃ samārabhettaṃ vicāraya yatnena nāḍicakrodare sthitamekaika bhramataiṣā vai prāṇāpānāntara sthitāp. 47a) prāṇaṃ teṣāṃ bhavet prāṇaṃ praṇamya tu paraṃ viduḥpiṅgalā tu bhavennābhistasya cakrasya ṣaṇmukhataṃ jñātvā paśyate vatsa śivaṃ parama kāraṇamtadā gamya sthitaṃ devaṃ piṅgalābhyantare sthitamtasya madhye sthitaṃ devaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyatikadambagolakākāraṃ sūryakoṭi samaprabhamp. 47b) anumānaṃ na vai tasya hetunā naiva dṛśyatetatastvā yatanaṃ gacchenmānusaṃ mānasena tuadhunā śrotumicchāmi hṛdguhyeśvara pūjanamidaṃ guhyaṃ tvayaivādya yanna kasyāpi bhāṣitam*? yajanti sa jīvaistu jīvaiścicchakti sambhavaiḥp. 48a) sa cetanāni bhūtāni yasmāt tāneva mohayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00262 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivātmā dṛṣṭa rūpeṇa sarvatraiva vyavasthitaḥbhuñjate tu parāśaktiḥ paraṃ cātra alepakamevaṃ jñātvā ahiṃsāṃ vai sarvabhūteṣu kārayethiṃsā yuktena yogena sambhāra bahulena caamānāmnā tu yogena hiṃsā bhavati sarvadāp. 48b) evaṃ jñātvā yajet sarvaṃ mānusaṃ yāgamuttamamsamaṃ paśyati sarveṣāmahiṃsā procyate tu sāsamuktaḥ prakṛterbandhācchive tiṣṭhati śāśvateantaḥ karṇādikaṃ vatsa yanmayoktaṃ hi darśaneantaḥkaraṇa vinyāsaṃ bhūtaśuddhyartha kāraṇamkṛtvāntaḥ karaṇaṃ vatsa bhūtaśuddhiṃ tathaiva cap. 49a) ātmajñaṃ tu punarvatsa nityaśuddhaṃ sadā bhavetnitya śuddhi hitaṃ bhūtvā na kiñcit sādhayatyasauyasya śaktirbhavatyugrā yaḥ śodhayati vai paramatorthāt ketanaṃ vatsa ātmajñe niṣprayojanamsa eva paramaṃ dāma tatra śuddhyati te khilaṃyathoktena vidhānena samyg yoga balena tup. 49b) yajante devatāssarve brahmādyāśca maharṣayaḥyogārthaṃ dravya sambhāraṃ taṃ hi cātraiva tiṣṭhatitaṃ labhiṣyasi sarvaṃ vai mānase taṃ śikhidhvajaubhau tāvekadā vatsa yajatvaṃ yat tu rocatemanasā citsvabhāvena sākārā kriyate kriyātasmāt tvaṃ sarvadā vatsa nityaṃ śakti sthitaṃ yajetcitsaṃjñā citsamudbhutā bhutābhuteṣu saṃsthitāsaṃsthitāścivatattve rasadasarvagato vibhuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00262 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taṃ hi pūjaya yatvena vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇātasmāttaṃ pūjayedvatsa ahiṃsā kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥdānāni yāni coktāni śivadharmekhilāni tusarvakāmāni vai tadvatmānasaṃ yāga muttamamiḍādayo yajed yastu rājasaṃ yāgamucyatesuṣumṇe tvāṃ parityajya piṅgalā nāḍisthaṃ yajettasmin madhye sthitaṃ devaṃ taṃ nedaṃ pūjayet tu saḥturyodbhavati? sarvāṇi turyasthāne gatāni tuturyasthāne layaṃ kṛtvā hṛdhisthaṃ pūjayet sadāhṛdisthaṃ turyasaṃsthaṃ tu ubhau yo vetti tatvataḥprāṇāpānāntarasthena śivena śikhivāhanaprāṇāpānau tu sandigdhau rajastamasamanvitausātvikaṃ saṅgamaṃ teṣāṃ tena kuryācchivārcanambrahmādi stambha paryantaṃ trailokyaṃ sa carācaramp. 51b) mānase naiva yāgena muktohaṃ sarvadā vibhotathāpi jñātu micchāmi japyaṃ vai sarvadā paramrahasyaṃ caiva guhyaṃ ca japyaṃ japyottamottamamna punarmānasaṃ japyaṃ mokṣamārgaphalapradamtadāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi rahasyaṃ kṛttikā sutasa tu saṅkhyā yate japyaṃ japaṃ tu kurute tu saḥp. 52a) pratyahaṃ pratyahaṃ vatsa japasaṅkhyaṃ karoti saḥsūrya cicchaktirityāhustasmiṃste kathitā guhaye sthitā phalasandhāne vaśyākarṣaṇamāraṇepunarātma vide vatsa mantra tantraiḥ prayojanamtaṃ viditvā mahāsena mantratantrāṃstyajedguha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00262 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatohaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yathā bhavati tacchṛṇuśivajapyaṃ bhavedeṣa śivaṃ hyaśiva kāriṇamubhau cākarṣayedyastu sa japaṃ kurute guhaevāṃ gamāgamaṃ jñeyaṃ taṃ japaṃ brahmaśāśvatamagnikāryaṃ ca metātatatvamācakṣva vai prabhobhūyopi kathayiṣyāmi agnikāryaṃ tu mānasamhṛdisthaṃ paramaṃ tejo na tu jānanti mohitāḥjvalanasya tu tat tejaḥ pūrṇamindustathaiva cabāhyegnīnāṃ hutaṃ havyaṃ hiṃsanti guhyakādayaḥtadā te lupyate vatsa bāhyāgniṣu hutaṃ haviḥyadātra hūyate yasmāt tasmāt taṃ hiṃsapūrvakamśivāgnirvaibhavatyeṣa śivamaśivahāriṇamna hi kuṇḍaṃ nu vaḥ kāryaṃ mekhalairvātha yoninākuṇḍatrayaṃ sthitaṃ dehe agni tritayameva camukhakuṇḍe sthitaṃ vatsa nāmnācāhavaniyakamteṣāṃ homaṃ prakurvīta vidhi dṛṣṭena karmaṇādakṣiṇāgniṃ tato juhyānnābhikuṇḍe sthite guhatadācāhavanīyognirmukhakuṇḍe sthito guhatasmin pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyādviṣuvatkaraṇena tutasmin kāle yajed yastu tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavetprāṇādyā vāyavaḥ pañca homayet tu yathā kramamamṛtaṃ bhavate vatsa amṛtaṃ taṃtu tiṣṭhatiprāṇāpānāntarasthaṃ tu yairjñātaṃ śikhivāahanaturyodbhavāmṛtājyena nityamagniṃ prapūjayet
